bridge-type.label: Transit Bridge
bridge-type.description: Bridge to connect to Transit API

parameter.name: apiKey
parameter.label: API Key
parameter.description: Your personal Transit API key (required)

parameter.name: cacheTimeMs
parameter.label: Cache Time
parameter.description: How long to cache API responses in milliseconds (5000–300000)

parameter.name: retryAfterSeconds
parameter.label: Retry After
parameter.description: Default retry-after value when API rate limit is hit (1–600 seconds)

parameter.name: maxDepartures
parameter.label: Max Departures
parameter.description: Maximum number of departures to display per stop (1–10)

thing-type.label: Stop
thing-type.description: Represents a transit stop for monitoring upcoming departures

parameter.name: globalStopId
parameter.label: Global Stop ID
parameter.description: The global stop ID from Transit API. Several stops can be combined with a comma-separated list (e.g. "VVSDE:2298,VVSDE:2394").

parameter.name: refreshInterval
parameter.label: Refresh Interval
parameter.description: Time in seconds between updates

thing-type.label: Route Details
thing-type.description: Detailed information about a specific transit route

parameter.name: routeId
parameter.label: Route ID
parameter.description: The global route ID from Transit API

parameter.name: refreshInterval
parameter.label: Refresh Interval
parameter.description: Time in seconds between updates

thing-type.label: Trip Details
thing-type.description: Detailed stop-by-stop schedule for a specific trip

parameter.name: tripSearchKey
parameter.label: Trip Search Key
parameter.description: The trip search key from Transit API (changes as feeds are updated)

parameter.name: refreshInterval
parameter.label: Refresh Interval
parameter.description: Time in seconds between updates

parameter.name: targetStopId
parameter.label: Target Stop ID
parameter.description: Destination stop ID to calculate the time-to-target countdown (optional)

thing-type.label: Network Alerts
thing-type.description: Active service alerts of one or more transit networks

parameter.name: networkIds
parameter.label: Network IDs
parameter.description: One network ID or a comma-separated list of network IDs (e.g. "VVS|Stuttgart")

parameter.name: refreshInterval
parameter.label: Refresh Interval
parameter.description: Time in seconds between updates

thing-type.label: Journey
thing-type.description: Plans a trip between two places and shows the itinerary that arrives first

parameter-group.name: from
parameter-group.label: Start
parameter-group.description: Either a stop ID or a location

parameter-group.name: to
parameter-group.label: Destination
parameter-group.description: Either a stop ID or a location

parameter.name: fromStopId
parameter.label: Start Stop ID
parameter.description: Global stop ID of the start (has priority over the start location)

parameter.name: fromLocation
parameter.label: Start Location
parameter.description: Location of the start (latitude,longitude)

parameter.name: toStopId
parameter.label: Destination Stop ID
parameter.description: Global stop ID of the destination (has priority over the destination location)

parameter.name: toLocation
parameter.label: Destination Location
parameter.description: Location of the destination (latitude,longitude)

parameter.name: refreshInterval
parameter.label: Refresh Interval
parameter.description: Time in seconds between updates

thing-type.label: Vehicles
thing-type.description: Real-time positions of the vehicles of a route

parameter.name: routeId
parameter.label: Route ID
parameter.description: The global route ID from Transit API

parameter.name: directionId
parameter.label: Direction
parameter.description: Only show the vehicles of one direction

parameter.name: refreshInterval
parameter.label: Refresh Interval
parameter.description: Time in seconds between updates

channel-group-type.label: Journey
channel-group-type.description: The planned itinerary that arrives first

channel-group-type.label: Vehicles
channel-group-type.description: Summary of all vehicles of the route

channel-type.description: Full name of the route

channel-type.label: Route Short Name

channel-type.label: Departure Time
channel-type.description: Departure time (real-time if available)

channel-type.label: Cancelled
channel-type.description: Whether the departure has been cancelled

channel-type.label: Minutes Until Departure
channel-type.description: Time remaining until departure in minutes

channel-type.label: Delay

channel-type.label: Headsign

channel-type.label: Last Departure

channel-type.label: Global Stop ID
channel-type.description: Global stop ID of the stop the departure belongs to

channel-type.label: Trip Search Key
